desc:
CORN CEREAL: These crispy corn puffs are a good source of calcium and vitamin D to help build and maintain strong bones

EASY BREAKFAST: This sweet, crunchy kids breakfast cereal is the perfect pantry staple for a wholesome start

WHOLE GRAIN: With whole grain as the first ingredient, each serving provides 21g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily)

KIDS SNACKS: Crispy corn puffs are a great addition to family mornings or any healthy snacks bag. Be sure to try every Kix Cereal flavor

CONTAINS: One 12 oz cereal box of General Mills Kix Breakfast Cereal
features:
Features

Made with Whole Grain Corn

Each serving provides 21g of whole grain to support a healthy diet.

Low in Sugar

Contains only 4g of added sugar per serving, making it a smarter breakfast option.

Free from Artificial Ingredients

No artificial flavors, colors, or preservatives.

Fortified with Vitamins & Minerals

Includes key nutrients like iron, calcium, zinc, and B vitamins.

Low Fat and Cholesterol-Free

Just 1g total fat per serving and no cholesterol.

Crunchy, Oven-Toasted Texture

Light and crispy corn puffs that stay crunchy in milk.

Kid-Tested, Parent-Approved

A trusted choice with a mild, sweet flavor that appeals to both kids and adults.

Benefits

Supports Healthy Growth and Development

Fortified with essential vitamins and minerals needed for growing bodies.

Promotes Whole Grain Intake

Helps meet daily whole grain recommendations with every bowl.

Smart Choice for Sugar-Conscious Families

Lightly sweetened to satisfy without overloading on sugar.

Versatile Snack Option

Great as a dry snack, in lunchboxes, or as a base for homemade snack mixes.

Digestive Health Support

With 3g of dietary fiber per serving, it aids in healthy digestion.

Clean and Simple Ingredients

A straightforward recipe parents can feel good about.
ingredients: Whole Grain Corn, Corn Meal, Sugar, Salt, Brown Sugar Syrup, Baking Soda. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
